cases.prompt: My HELEN plan has five read-only audits followed by one step that rewrites code. I use Claude Code with subagents. How should I run this? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Runs the read-only audits in parallel, one subagent per audit
Runs the code-rewriting step alone, after the audits are finished
Has each worker claim its item before working so two agents never take the same one
Keeps results where the next step can read them instead of relying on conversation memory

cases.prompt: Codex and Claude Code are both about to edit src/api/ in the same repo. What should we do so they do not overwrite each other? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Has each agent declare the files or folders it will edit and refuses overlapping scopes
Serializes the two writers or gives them disjoint paths
Suggests a handoff message so the second agent knows what the first changed

cases.prompt: An agent crashed halfway through a work item and its lease says it is still claimed. The rest of the plan is blocked behind it. What now? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains that the lease expires on its own and the item becomes available again
Offers an explicit release of the claim as the faster option instead of editing claim files by hand
Says to check partial work before another agent resumes it

cases.prompt: The tests fail on the checkpoint step but a worker agent says everything is fine and wants to mark the checkpoint done. Allow it? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Refuses to accept the worker's word and requires a passing verification run of the project's own checks
Says forcing a checkpoint is a deliberate exception that needs a stated reason and the user's decision
Does not suggest weakening or skipping the failing tests

cases.prompt: What is the difference between git merge and git rebase? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains that merge preserves history with a merge commit while rebase rewrites commits onto a new base
Warns against rebasing commits that are already shared

cases.prompt: There is a typo in the README title: 'Instalation'. What should I do? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says to fix it directly (Installation) without any multi-agent setup
Keeps the answer to a sentence or two
